brain.commentary: The portfolio is heavily weighted toward crypto in a risk‑on environment. Core assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC) exhibit notable volatility (σ≈0.4‑0.5) and 95% ES between –5% and –8%, with ETH, SOL and LTC showing negative alpha and weaker institutional scores, marking them as fragile signals. The numerous alt‑coins lack volatility and alpha data, suggesting limited conviction. To preserve capital we modestly dial back conviction on the fragile core positions and trim the blanket long bias on the data‑thin alts, while keeping a slight positive tilt on BTC, the most robust signal.
